observations.title: Agent-callable interfaces are the largest API / AI group.
observations.evidence: 177 of 543 records are grouped as agent-callable interfaces, led by MCP/tool surfaces, workers, configs, and policy attachments.
observations.implication: The repo is already shaped around MCP/API capability creation more than a single application surface.

observations.title: Knowledge is operating tissue, not just documentation.
observations.evidence: Public / Learning Surface is 62.5% guide/doc, Agent Automation is 41.3% guide/doc, and AI Orchestration is 35.5% guide/doc.
observations.implication: Playbooks appear to be where repeated delivery decisions become reusable workflow behavior.

observations.title: Governance is cross-cutting infrastructure.
observations.evidence: Machine-Readable Governance has 125 structural cross-group edges and 1.52 structural cross edges per node.
observations.implication: Policy/Judgment is not isolated content; it binds runtime, agents, and MCP capability.

observations.title: Raw topology is still dominated by containment edges.
observations.implication: Operational and structural edge modes are necessary for reading business implications; raw edge count overstates root/substrate centrality.
